quarterly_data.quarter: Infineon press release: Infineon extends collaboration with SolarEdge to enable (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Infineon and SolarEdge extended their collaboration to solid-state circuit breaker (SSCB) technology for high-voltage DC distribution in AI and hyperscale data centers (800 VDC architecture): SolarEdge leads the SSCB design, with Infineon providing its CoolSiC silicon carbide JFET technology at the core of the protection devices; the SSCBs are designed to interrupt faults within a few microseconds. It builds on SolarEdge's solid-state transformer (SST) platform with Infineon SiC components, first announced in November 2025, designed for direct medium-voltage (13.8-34.5 kV) to 800-1500 VDC conversion at over 99 percent efficiency.
quarterly_data.figure: SST: 13.8-34.5 kV to 800-1500 VDC at over 99% efficiency (design target)
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: partner (SSCB / SST designer using Infineon SiC)
